Definition: graciousness, i.e. subjective (kindness, favor) or objective (beauty)
BiblicalUsage: Chen is favour, the grace that makes someone welcome in another's eyes, and it runs through the whole story of Scripture. Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord, Moses found grace before God, Ruth found grace in the eyes of Boaz, and Proverbs says the wise find favour and good understanding with God and men.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe grace is the thread that holds the Bible together, because every blessing in it begins with God choosing to look on someone with favour. I hold that we never earn it, we only receive it, and that is why Noah, Moses and Ruth all stand where they stand.
